results.title: MoD Denies DRDO Cyberattack Reports
results.description: Defence Ministry dismisses reports of a DRDO cyberattack as unverified. Officials say no evidence of active cyber attack or data exfiltration. Alleged leaked documents described as outdated and largely unclassified. Probe suggests threat actors fabricated material to create panic and earn money. results.title: Audi Q9 Debuts As Brand's Biggest SUV Yet; India Launch On Cards
results.description: Audi has introduced the Q9, its largest and priciest SUV, positioned above the Q7. It will target the ultra-luxury segment here, competing with established models like the BMW X7 and Mercedes-Benz GLS.
